citation.title: KSTAR Charge Exchange Spectroscopy System
citation.authors: Won-Ha Ko; Seungtae Oh; Myeun Kwon

topic: Design status of the early KSTAR CES diagnostic: cassette optics, modulated NBI with background subtraction, 1.33-m Czerny-Turner spectrometer, EMCCD detector, and simulated S/N.
own_question: How should a KSTAR CES system be designed to give local impurity Ti and rotation profiles with adequate S/N?
actual_method_and_evidence: This is a hardware and design description. The spectrometer and CCD were bench-tested on a helium discharge. S/N and detection efficiency come from a von Hellermann simulation code under assumed conditions (for example, 1 MW NBI, r/a=0.3, CVI line). The paper reports no plasma CES measurements and no validated profiles. The stated 10 ms resolution and 4 cm spatial resolution are planned specifications for 2010.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR CES was designed to infer impurity (e.g., CVI 529 nm) ion temperature from active charge-exchange emission. Its design relies on beam modulation and background subtraction, which makes the analysis nontrivial.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.996 Abstract and Introduction; p.997 Sec. III-B; p.998 Sec. III-C
claim_checks.qualification: These describe the design plan in 2010, not the configuration of the 2022 campaign. The measured quantity is impurity Ti, not main-ion Ti.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: The design targeted CES profiles at roughly 10 ms resolution, and the authors' simulations indicated that S/N worsens at low NBI power and high Ti.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.998 Sec. III-C/D, Sec. IV-A; p.999 Fig. 5 text
claim_checks.qualification: These are simulated or planned values, not achieved performance. The 10 ms figure is not the report arrival latency in our data. No figures were visually checked.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The source gives a planned 10 ms time resolution for CES. It does not report actual report arrival times or analysis latency; these remain unknown.
validation_if_relevant: None for plasma Ti. The source contains only simulated S/N and bench tests of the hardware.
forbidden_inferences: That CES reports in KSTAR2022 arrive every 10 ms or with a known delay.
That CES labels are independent physical truth.
That the 2010 hardware matches the 2022 system or the provider-selected chord.
That simulated S/N equals achieved precision.
That the paper motivates nowcasting or covers BES/ECEI.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as a citation for the background of the KSTAR CES diagnostic: what it measures (impurity Ti), its modulation and background-subtraction design, and its design-stage resolution. It should be cited only as a design-stage reference.
